source.title: Satellite-detected mudflow and rockflow extent in Rasuwa and Nuwakot
source.what_it_shows: Preliminary satellite-mapped mudflow and rockflow extent following the 26 August Rasuwa/Nuwakot flood.
source.what_it_does_not_prove: It does not identify the cause of NISAR backscatter changes outside its mapped polygons, or establish no impact outside its analyzed area.

method: Exact polygon intersection in EPSG:32645; top 10 ranked by nominal area then absolute median signed change.

source_screening.interpretation: No overlap does not imply no change; source mapping covers a different event footprint and is preliminary.

optical_limit: Sentinel-2 tile metadata screened; image pixels and per-region cloud masks not inspected.
